_source: docs/content-bible.md §6 (towns/routes) + §4 habitats + §5 (populations live in ONE JSON per node). This file is simultaneously the encounter-table source, the ecology sim initial state and the bait lookup. G3: there is no second table anywhere — encounter weight of a species IS populations[s].count.
_pyramid: Counts are authored by published rule, never by taste. Per-node scale S (towns/sites S=3, routes S=4) sets the role budget: Producer 8S · Grazer 6S · Mesopredator 2S · Apex ~0.75S · Scavenger ~0.6S, split across the lines bible §4 puts in this biome; Ancients are one gated individual (count 1, breedRate 0, carryCap 1). The budget is a trophic pyramid by construction (producers > grazers > mesopredators > apex) and is calibrated against balance.ecosim.demandPerIndividual so that (a) nothing starves at the shipped state and (b) an Apex whose derived prey pool falls to 10% starves at EVERY node that has one — build-doc §10.2 `cascade_emerges`, gated by tests/unit/transcription.test.ts. Slice-node totals are additionally bounded by catch throughput so the year-1 over-catch demo beat is reachable in real play (build-doc §1 beat 1 / §15 I2).
_breedRule: breedRate is per-season fractional growth, assigned by the line's ADULT role (balance.ecosim.webRoleAgeClass): Producer 0.09 · Grazer 0.06 · Mesopredator 0.045 · Apex 0.03 · Scavenger 0.05 · Ancient 0. Rates are set below the player's maximum catch throughput at this node so sustained over-catching drives a population DOWN (the year-1 cascade beat) while an untouched node still recovers across the six years. carryCap = 3 × count (Ancients 1).
name: Hearthollow

edgeMouths._note: PINNED TO THE MAP'S OWN EDGE MOUTH. tools/mapgen/layouts/hearthollow.txt is the one document the painting and the collision mask are both stamped from, and it draws a '^' edge-mouth cell for every declared adjacency — legend kind edge-mouth, 'the cell where a corridor meets the map edge; one per declared adjacency'. This is cell (41,0) on the TOP edge, and the layout's own header assigns that edge: "# top edge     r1, ONE mouth, cells (40,0)-(42,0), ^ at (41,0) — the timber field gate," (hearthollow.txt:23). Cell (41,0) spans native (656..672, 0..16); x/y below are its CENTRE, so OverworldScene.mouthTileOf — floor(x * balance.map.mapRenderScale / balance.map.tileStepPx) — lands on tile 41,0: the cell the layout marks, walkable in the shipped mask and four-connected to the spawn tile. THE COORDINATE IS READ OFF THE GRID, NEVER OFF HEADER PROSE: r2.txt's header still names a bottom mouth at (31,63) that its own decisions block records as moved to col 38. tests/unit/edge-mouth-travel.test.ts holds every mouth to the shipped layout and the shipped mask. Units are map-native pixels in the 1024-square painted map, the same space this file's props[] use.
